A directed road grid supplies known lag coefficients and a broad candidate dictionary. The design crosses the location of the active sources with static or dynamic coefficients. The continuous GLS fit and its validation-selected DSS projection share a posterior.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("report.R", local = TRUE)
x <- read_experiment(params$results, "02-sparse-grid")
```

**Run scope.** Profile **`r x$config$profile`**, `r length(unique(x$jobs$scenario))` generated scenario(s), `r length(unique(x$jobs$replicate))` distinct replicate ID(s). `r if (x$config$profile == "smoke") "This execution check uses reduced dimensions or sampling budgets. Its scores cannot establish method rankings." else "Interpret comparisons using independent replicated panels and their paired Monte Carlo uncertainty."`

## Forecast comparison

The table gives method minus static all-pairs Poisson lasso on test deviance. Use the same scenarios to compare static GLS, constant-affinity GLS and graph-informed GLS. With one matched dataset the Monte Carlo standard error is unavailable.

```{r primary, echo=FALSE}
primary_report(x, "poisson-lasso", "all", "deviance")
```

## Network recovery

For the continuous GLS fit, selection means that the fitted trajectory exceeds the amplitude threshold with posterior probability above one half. DSS selects by validation prediction loss.

```{r recovery, echo=FALSE}
z <- subset(x$scores, window == "pairs-cross" & metric %in% c("trajectory_rmse", "recall") & is.finite(value))
z <- subset(z, method %in% c("gls", "gls-dss", "gls-static", "poisson-lasso"))
if (nrow(z)) {
  averages <- aggregate(value ~ scenario + method + metric, z, mean)
  knitr::kable(reshape(averages, idvar=c("scenario", "method"), timevar="metric",
                       direction="wide"), digits=3, row.names=FALSE)
}
```

## Sparsity and test loss

The curve follows the candidate graphs in one saved replication. The symbols locate the two decisions made using validation data. All candidates and replications are in `support-path.csv`.

```{r support-path, echo=FALSE, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=3.6, fig.alt="Test deviance against number of retained relations for validation-selected graph candidates"}
path_file <- file.path(params$results, "support-path.csv")
if (file.exists(path_file)) {
  path <- read.csv(path_file)
  available <- unique(path$scenario[path$method == "gls"])
  cell <- if ("mixed-dynamic" %in% available) "mixed-dynamic" else head(available, 1)
  curve <- subset(path, method == "gls" & scenario %in% cell)
  if (nrow(curve)) {
    rep_id <- min(curve$replicate)
    curve <- subset(curve, replicate == rep_id & is.finite(test_deviance))
    if (nrow(curve)) {
      curve <- curve[order(curve$n_selected), ]
      plot(curve$n_selected, curve$test_deviance, type="b", col="#234b56",
           xlab="Retained relations", ylab="Mean test deviance",
           main=paste(cell, "• replication", rep_id))
      points(curve$n_selected[curve$one_se], curve$test_deviance[curve$one_se], pch=17, col="#ad461b", cex=1.5)
      points(curve$n_selected[curve$tolerance], curve$test_deviance[curve$tolerance], pch=1, col="#376d36", cex=2)
      legend("topright", c("One standard error", "0.7% tolerance"), pch=c(17,1),
             col=c("#ad461b","#376d36"), bty="n", cex=.8)
    }
  }
}
```

## Reproduce from the repository root

Set `RESULTS` to the external results directory. The generator stores a panel and its identity. The fit driver reads the panel and records a job by method. The comparison driver collects scores, numbers of matched replicates, Monte Carlo errors, and incomplete jobs. Select another cell with `--scenario` or an individual fit with `--method`.

```sh
CASE=GLS-paper/experiments/02-sparse-grid
Rscript "$CASE/generate.R" --output="$RESULTS" --profile=smoke --scenario=mixed-dynamic --replicate=1
Rscript "$CASE/fit.R" --output="$RESULTS" --profile=smoke --scenario=mixed-dynamic --replicate=1 --method=all
Rscript "$CASE/compare.R" --output="$RESULTS" --profile=smoke
Rscript GLS-paper/reports/render.R 02-sparse-grid "$RESULTS/02-sparse-grid"
```

The full results directory contains the individual job statuses, all metrics in `comparison.csv`, and replicate-level paired differences in `paired-replicates.csv`. Rendering reads those saved results.
